image_description: A close-up view of an open comic book spread featuring dark, atmospheric artwork. The layout consists of multiple panels with illustrated characters in action poses, speech bubbles containing text, and caption boxes. The art style is gritty with high contrast lighting, typical of horror or superhero genres. Text is visible in speech bubbles and title blocks, though some appears slightly distorted or stylized.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The text within the speech bubbles and captions is largely illegible or resembles pseudo-text/gibberish rather than clear alphanumeric characters. This is a common AI artifact where the model mimics the shape of text without generating readable content.

Some panel borders appear slightly uneven or bleed into the adjacent artwork. There are minor inconsistencies in the halftone dot patterns, which look more like digital noise than intentional print textures.
The anatomy of the character in the bottom right panel is somewhat ambiguous, with limbs blending into the background or weapon props, lacking clear structural definition.
